reviewMethod.wholeSourcePurity: Every clip was reviewed across full-source 15 fps whole-body/lower-body evidence. Potential passes were re-reviewed with native ~30 fps foot/body windows.
reviewMethod.countPolicy: Only clips passing whole-source subtype purity were counted. Programmatic motion/centroid analysis was used only to propose candidate timestamps; every admitted cycle, long gap, and source boundary was visually checked.
reviewMethod.strictPolicy: Any alternate-foot, high-knee, boxer/lateral step, crossover, or mixed subtype anywhere rejects the clip from STANDARD.
reviewMethod.datasetRolePolicy: UCF archive partition is preserved directly: train=TRAIN, val=VALIDATION, test=HOLDOUT.
